data_description.name: E.g. Living room
data_description.valves: Valves of this room. The room target is the target set on the valve (highest one if several).
data_description.temperature_sensor: If set, heat demand is calculated from it instead of the valve's own reading. Falls back to the valves if unavailable.
data_description.valve_control: When the room thermometer says it is cold, the valve target is temporarily raised to the valve maximum (valve fully opens) and restored to the original value once the target is reached. Requires a temperature sensor.
data_description.valve_boost_threshold: Only relevant with automatic valve control. If empty, the value from Settings applies.
data_description.valve_boost_delay: How long the deviation must persist before boosting. 0 = immediately. If empty, the global value applies.
data_description.valve_release_margin: The valve gets its original target back this far before the target. Must be below the threshold. If empty, the global value applies.
data_description.valve_demand_link: When on, the room only calls the boiler when its valve is open (valve's own reading is below its target) or when the plugin is forcing it open. Avoids firing the boiler into closed valves for small deviations. Does not block heating if valve data is missing.
data_description.humidity_sensor: At high humidity the room target is raised slightly (see Settings).
data_description.window_sensors: While a window or door stays open longer than the delay, the room stops calling for heat and the valve boost is released. With several sensors, any open one counts.
data_description.window_open_delay: How long the window must stay open before the room reacts, so short airing changes nothing. 0 = immediately. If empty, the global value applies.
data_description.calibrate_valves: Corrects the valves' temperature readings using the room thermometer. Only works with a room temperature sensor. When off, this room's valves are left alone.
data_description.trv_offset: Calibration sets the valve's reading not to the room thermometer but to a value this much colder. In a room below its target the valve then opens fully instead of only partly for a small error. The target temperature does not change. While the boiler runs for other rooms, this room can end up at most this much warmer than its target. 0 = off (the valve's reading follows the room thermometer); otherwise at least 1.0, 1.0–1.5 °C recommended. Only works with valve calibration switched on and a room thermometer set.

data.boiler_on_temp: Boiler target when heating (0 = don't change)
data.valve_boost_threshold: Valve boost threshold – default (how far below target)
data.valve_dry_run: Valve control dry run (log only, no writes to valves)

data_description.hysteresis: A room calls for heat when this much below target, and keeps calling until the target is reached.
data_description.min_switch_time: Minimum time between boiler on/off switches.
data_description.boiler_on_temp: Target set on the boiler thermostat when heat is needed.
data_description.humidity_max_boost: Target rises gradually from 60% humidity and reaches this value at 80%. No boost for targets below 17 °C.
data_description.valve_boost_threshold: Default for all rooms, can be overridden per room. Automatic valve control only boosts when the room is at least this far below target. For smaller deviations the valve decides alone and the radiator's residual heat is usually enough. (Boiler demand still starts at the hysteresis.)
data_description.valve_boost_delay: The deviation must persist this long before boosting, giving the radiator's residual heat a chance to warm the room. If the deviation exceeds the threshold by 1 °C (e.g. you raised the target) there is no wait. 0 = immediately.
data_description.valve_release_margin: The valve gets its original target back this far before the room reaches the target, since the radiator's residual heat keeps warming the room (prevents overshoot). Must be smaller than the boost threshold.
data_description.stale_check_enabled: When on, a sensor that has not reported for the time below is treated as unavailable (the room falls back to the valve's own reading, valve boost stops, and a Repairs notice appears). Also applies to the outdoor sensor.
data_description.stale_hours: Battery sensors can freeze at their last value without becoming unavailable. Set this to at least twice the sensor's usual reporting interval, otherwise you get false alarms.
data_description.max_boost_enabled: When on, the valve boost is stopped after the maximum duration below (protects against an open window, a misplaced sensor or a frozen value).
data_description.max_boost_hours: After this long the valve gets its original target back, even if the room has not reached the target.
data_description.max_boost_rest_minutes: How long no new boost is started after reaching the maximum duration. The room reaching its target resets this.
data_description.window_open_delay: Default for all rooms: how long a window must stay open before heating for that room is paused. Shorter airing changes nothing.
data_description.valve_dry_run: When on, valve control only logs what it would do ([PRÓBAÜZEM] prefix) and changes nothing on the valves. Recommended for the first live test.
data_description.register_card: When on, the integration adds the card file to the dashboard resources (Settings → Dashboards → Resources) and keeps its version up to date, so it appears in the 'Add card' list (it never adds a card to a dashboard by itself). With YAML-mode dashboards you have to add the resource manually (see README). When off, the integration does not touch the resources.

summer.title: Summer mode
summer.description: In summer mode there is no heat demand and the boiler thermostat is switched off. It is active when the date is inside the summer period AND the outdoor 24h average is above the threshold. Without a sensor summer mode is disabled.

features.title: Features
features.description:
Every feature can be switched on and off separately.

**Events**: the plugin sends `meross_boiler_sync_event` events (valve boost, window, stale sensor, short cycling, Heat now, preheat) that you can use in automations; they are also readable in the HA logbook.

**Boiler cycle monitoring**: counts boiler starts and flags short cycling.

**Protection**: when on, the boiler stays on / off for at least the given time even if room demand changes meanwhile. This can delay heating, so it is off by default.

**Heat now**: the `meross_boiler_sync.boost_now` service (and the cards' button) temporarily raises the room's target. It does not start in summer mode, with an open window or a stale sensor.

**Preheat**: warms the room up for a given time, working out from the learned heating rate when to start. Set the weekly schedule under *Preheat schedule* in the main menu. It starts by itself, so it is off by default.

**Gas estimate**: creates an estimated gas consumption sensor (m³) that you can pick under *Gas consumption* on the Energy dashboard. It multiplies the boiler's on-time by the gas consumption set below. It is an estimate, not a measurement, and it is off by default.

**Valve calibration** (experimental): adjusts each radiator valve's temperature reading to match the room thermometer, through the valve's *Calibration* number entity. It only measures when the radiator has cooled down (the boiler or the valve has not been heating for at least 90 minutes), with a stable room temperature and closed windows, and only changes the value if the difference is at least 0.8 °C. Every change is verified and reverted if it did not help; after two failed attempts the valve is suspended for a week (a Repairs notice appears). The boiler thermostat is never touched. *Dry run* only logs what it would change. It writes a persistent setting into the valve, so it is off by default; turning it off keeps the values already set.

data.cycle_min_avg_on_minutes: Short cycling: lower limit of the average on-time (0 = not monitored)
data.boiler_min_on_minutes: Protection: keep the boiler on for at least
data.boiler_min_off_minutes: Protection: keep the boiler off for at least
data.preheat_max_minutes: Preheat: earliest start before the ready time
data.preheat_hold_minutes: Preheat: hold the target after the ready time
data.manual_boost_end_on_target: Heat now: end when the room reaches the raised target
data.gas_m3_per_hour: Gas estimate: gas use while the boiler is on

data_description.trv_log: When on, the integration writes every valve and calibration decision (what it changed from what to what, when it switched the boiler, why the calibration is waiting) as separate lines in Settings › System › Logs. The lines start with “TRV-napló ▸”: in the “Home Assistant Core” log use the Integrations filter or the search box to see only them. The integration sets the level of this log channel itself; you do not need to change the Home Assistant logger settings. When off, these lines are not shown (warnings and errors still are). The lines are written in Hungarian.
data_description.cycle_max_starts_per_hour: If the boiler started this many times or more in the last hour, the Short cycling sensor turns on.
data_description.cycle_min_avg_on_minutes: If the average on-time of the last 2 hours (from at least 3 cycles) is shorter, it also reports.
data_description.cycle_protection_enabled: The boiler is not switched off / on again before the minimum time has passed. The Minimum switching time (Basic settings) still applies.
data_description.manual_boost_offset: How much the room's target is raised during Heat now. The valve is opened right away by valve control (if enabled for the room).
data_description.preheat_max_minutes: Preheating never starts earlier than this, even if the room is very cold (default: 240 min).
data_description.preheat_default_rate: The plugin measures each room's heating rate while heating; until it has enough samples (about 20 minutes of heating) it uses this many degrees per hour.
data_description.manual_boost_end_on_target: When off, Heat now lasts for the full duration and holds the raised target.
data_description.gas_estimate_enabled: Adds the estimated gas consumption sensor. It counts the boiler's on-time; time while Home Assistant is not running is not counted.
data_description.gas_m3_per_hour: How many m³ of gas the boiler uses per hour while it is on (see the type plate or your bill). Compare the sensor with your gas meter reading and adjust this value until they match.
data_description.calibration_enabled: When on, the plugin automatically adjusts the valves' calibration value based on the room thermometer (Meross LAN: the *Calibration* number). Rooms can be switched off individually when editing the room. It writes a persistent setting into the valve, so try it in dry run first.
data_description.calibration_dry_run: Only logs and sends an event about what it would set, but does not write to the valve. Changes already in progress are not continued while dry run is on.
data_description.residual_comp: Measures, per room, how much the room keeps warming after its heat demand stops (the radiator's leftover heat) and learns it (median of the last 9 clean measurements, at least 4 needed). When on, it ends the room's demand that much earlier, but only the part beyond the allowed overshoot set below. The whole on/off band shifts down by the same amount, so the boiler does not start more often, but the room's average temperature also ends up about that much lower. Needs a room thermometer; does not act during Heat now or preheat.
data_description.residual_allow: How far above its target the room may go because of the residual heat. Only the part beyond this is compensated: with 0.3 °C and a learned residual heat of 0.8 °C the demand ends 0.5 °C earlier. 0 = try to land exactly on the target; at most 1.0. The correction is never more than 0.8 °C.

preheat.title: Preheat schedule
preheat.description: Pick the room whose weekly schedule you want to edit. Preheat only runs when it is switched on under Features.

preheat_menu.title: Preheat: {room}
preheat_menu.description:
Schedule of **{room}** (the room should be ready by the given time):

{entries}

preheat_add.title: New schedule row: {room}
preheat_add.description: On which days and by when the room should be at the given temperature. Preheat starts earlier by as much as the warm-up needs.

data_description.temperature: The room's target is raised to this during preheat (the valve's own target is not changed if it is higher).

stale_room_temp.title: Room temperature sensor is not updating
stale_room_temp.description: The temperature sensor {sensor} of room {room} has not reported for over {hours} hours (its battery may be empty or it lost its connection). The room now uses the valves' own reading and automatic valve control is paused. This notice disappears once the sensor reports again.

unreliable_room_temp.title: Room thermometer is not reliable
unreliable_room_temp.description: The temperature sensor {sensor} of room {room} reported an impossible or erratic value (for example an error value or fast up-and-down jumps), so it is ignored for {minutes} minutes. The room now uses the valves' own reading, and automatic valve control and valve calibration are paused. This notice disappears once the sensor gives plausible readings again.

stale_outdoor.title: Outdoor temperature sensor is not updating
stale_outdoor.description: The outdoor sensor {sensor} has not reported for over {hours} hours (its battery may be empty). Summer mode is switched off until it reports again, so heating stays allowed. This notice disappears once the sensor reports again.

calibration_suspended.title: Valve calibration suspended
calibration_suspended.description: On the {valve} valve in {room}, two calibration changes in a row did not bring the valve's reading closer to the room thermometer, so automatic calibration is suspended for this valve for {days} days. The previous value was restored. Check the valve's *Calibration* number and whether the valve really applies it. The notice disappears when the suspension ends or the feature is turned off.

boost_now.name: Heat now
boost_now.description: Temporarily raises the room's target (default: +2.0 °C for 60 minutes). It does not start in summer mode, with an open window or a stale sensor.

minutes.name: Duration
minutes.description: How many minutes it lasts (default: set under Features).

offset.name: Raise
offset.description: How many °C to raise the target by (default: set under Features).

preheat.name: Preheat
preheat.description: One-off preheat: the room reaches the target temperature by the given time.

ready_by.name: Ready by
ready_by.description: A time (the next such time) or a date and time.

target_temperature.name: Target temperature
target_temperature.description: Warm the room up to this.

hold_minutes.name: Hold
hold_minutes.description: How many minutes to hold the target after the ready time (default: set under Features).

cancel_preheat.name: Cancel preheat
cancel_preheat.description: Clears the one-off request and skips the running or next scheduled preheat.
